Fresh run, no model. Diverse probe: move right(4) then down(2) toward the green C-door, then interact(5), to learn movement axis/sign and whether the white figure relocates.

Figure moves freely so far (no collision). Need feet (now r20-28 c23-25) onto markers (r35-43 c38-40): +15row/+15col. Push right+down toward markers; this drives body into green wall (col41) to test whether green blocks movement or feet can reach markers through it.

Now 5 down + 4 right lands both feet exactly on both markers (verified feet==markers) with body fully CLEAR of green (overlap 0, body cols23-37 vs green col41+). Tests whether feet-on-markers wins when body does NOT overlap green (orient0 with body-over-green gave no reward).

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New L2 with 4 colored polyomino shapes (white/green/yellow/blue), each with red studs; structurally unlike L1 and synth model is L1-hardcoded. Probe single right-move to learn the control model: which shape(s) move, all together, or none (implying click-selection needed).

Translate +18 down/-3 left lands both feet EXACTLY on yellow studs with body fully clear of yellow (overlap 0) -- mirrors L1 win. Expect reward/progress on final move.
